newsitem.title: USA: Stoico sets growth profit margin targets.
newsitem.headline: Stoico sets growth profit margin targets.

text.p: Stoico Restaurant Group Inc said its 1997 goal is to experience gross profit margins similar to the nearly 42 percent achieved at many of its Spaghetti Jack's units and 37 percent at many of its Sub & Stuff units.

"Our goal for 1997 is to experience gross profit margins in these ranges at all of our restaurants by continuing to control costs and driving sales growth," said chairman Louis Stoico Jr in a statement.

The operator and franchisor of quick-service Italian casual dining restaurants opened four Spaghetti Jack's and sold one during 1996, increasing the total number to 14 at yearend, including six franchised units.
It opened five Sub & Stuff restaurants, raising the total at yearend to 21, including two franchised outlets.
Earlier Monday, Stoico reported a fourth-quarter loss of $0.16 per share compared with a year-ago loss of $0.42.
